title: Windchime: an Audiovisual Installation with Audio-Language Model implementations
abstract: arXiv:2611.26759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Windchime is an audiovisual installation in which spoken language retrieves music and interactive animations from an artist authored corpus. A local Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model transcribes each prompt while an audio-language model (ALM) embeds it and retrieval over 406 audio stems returns a soundscape with live coded Strudel fragments that layer into audio output. Simultaneously each spoken input results in retrieval of interactive Three.js animation scenes each containing unique tactile control via monome grid and arc hardware. Windchime distributes agency in three distinct directions; across the artist who authored the possible outputs, the ALM that influences what areas of the corpus can be retrieved, and the visitor whose spoken inputs result in multimodal embodied interaction.

translated_title: Windchime：一个采用音频-语言模型实现的视听装置作品
translated_abstract: Windchime 是一个视听装置作品，参观者通过口语语言从艺术家创作的语料库中检索音乐和交互式动画。本地自动语音识别（ASR）模型对每个语音提示进行转录，同时音频-语言模型（ALM）对其进行嵌入，通过对406个音频分轨的检索返回一个声景，其中包含实时编码的 Strudel 片段，这些片段层层叠加形成音频输出。与此同时，每个语音输入都会检索到交互式 Three.js 动画场景，每个场景都包含通过 monome grid 和 arc 硬件实现的独特触觉控制。Windchime 在三个不同的方向上分配了能动性：创作出可能输出的艺术家、影响语料库哪些区域能够被检索的音频-语言模型，以及通过语音输入实现多模态具身交互的参观者。
tldr: Windchime 是一个视听装置，参观者通过语音输入，借助本地语音识别与音频-语言模型从艺术家语料库中检索音乐和交互式动画，实现了在艺术家、模型与参观者三方之间分配能动性的多模态具身交互体验。
